events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs and fun activities. After the program, families are invited to stay and socialize or make a craft. This program is for children ages 0-5 years and their parents or caregivers.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs, rhymes and activities in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30 to 11:30 am. Drop in. No registration required, but space is limited.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs, rhymes and activities in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30 to 11:00 am. Children, parents and caregivers are invited to Stay and Play, from 11:00 to 11:30.  Drop-in. Space is limited.

events.title: EarlyON Music and Movement
events.description: Drop in and join EarlyON each Monday from July 6th to August 24th, for a Music & Movement program for families with children ages birth to 6 years old. Enjoy songs, stories, finger rhymes, socialize and more.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs and rhymes in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30am   to  11am .

events.title: EarlyON Together Time
events.description: This is a program for parents and caregivers with children from birth - 6 years. Families have the opportunity to socialize while children develop new skills in an early learning environment. This program is offered in partnership with the Malvern Family Resource Centre (MFRC) . This is a drop-in program. No registration required.

events.title: STEM Club
events.description: Join us at the library for a fun hour of stem related activities. Come out to build, create and code with Snap Circuits, Dash and Dot, Scratch Coding, LEGO, Magnetic Tiles and more! The club is intended for children aged 6 to 12 years. Due to the limited number of robots, participants may be asked to share with other participants. Drop-in. No registration is required.

events.title: Saturday Chess Club
events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. Please note: There is no chess club on Sat Nov 21 for our Big Fall Book Sale This is a drop-in program.

events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.

events.title: STEAM Lab
events.description: Join us for our weekly STEAM Lab (Ages 6-12) , where kids can explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math through fun, hands-on activities. From building simple robots and experimenting with Snap Circuits to creative design challenges and more, there’s always something new to discover. Activities change each week, so there’s always something new to explore!

events.title: Sunday Lego Club

Come out to build, create and code with Snap Circuits, Dash and Dot, Scratch Coding, LEGO, Magnetic Tiles and more! The club is intended for children aged 6 to 12 years. Due to the limited number of robots, participants may be asked to share with other participants. Drop-in. No registration is required.

events.title: STEAM Lab
events.description: Join us for our weekly STEAM Lab (Ages 6-12) , where kids can explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math through fun, hands-on activities. From building simple robots and experimenting with Snap Circuits to creative design challenges and more, there’s always something new to discover. Activities change each week, so there’s always something new to explore!

events.title: Sunday Lego Club
events.description: Join us each Sunday (barring scheduled closures) to build LEGO structures and have fun at the Forest Hill library! For children under 12 years and their families. Please ensure young children are accompanied by an adult.

events.title: Parent/Child Book Club
events.description: Calling all children ages 9 to 12 and their mother, father, grandmother, grandfather, or caregiver! Join our monthly family book club. One child 9 to 12, one parent/caregiver, one book per month. Last Monday of every month, unless noted otherwise.  Registration is required. Please register ONCE for your pair (child and caregiver).
